posts.name: Clueso MCP
posts.tagline: Create and edit videos by chatting
posts.description: Make videos with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Give Clueso an idea, deck, reference video, or recording, and it handles the whole video production: storyboard, scenes, voiceover, music, and editing, on-brand. Everything stays editable, by hand or by chat.

posts.name: WZRD
posts.tagline: AI-native documents, slides, forms and sheets that talk back
posts.description: WZRD is for teams and creators working with documents, slides, forms and sheets. Upload existing work or create from a prompt, then turn it into an AI experience users can engage with. Forms collect answers by speaking or typing. Sheets explain numbers out loud. Slides walk people through the story. Documents engage every user. The output stays conversational and responsive.

posts.name: Anomalo
posts.tagline: Your data is always talking. Don't miss what it's saying.
posts.description: Your data changes constantly. Anomalo Analyst tells you what matters before you know to ask. It proactively monitors your Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery data, surfaces important trends, anomalies, and shifts, and lets you investigate with follow-up questions in plain language. Every insight is verified against your data, with Anomalo helping distinguish real business changes from broken data.

posts.name: thestory.run
posts.tagline: A writing coach for corporate influencers.
posts.description: Your team already has things to say, they just don't know how. Our coach helps you stay consistent, find stories worth sharing and makes YOU the writer. Most AI tools take over writing. thestory.run flips it: the coach interviews you, finds the point you're circling, hands you the story arc, and you write it. It is the coach that helps you through it all: One real session, from a messy thought to a finished post. Between the posts, it keeps the week so you never have to guess what's next

posts.name: SereneDB
posts.tagline: Ultra-Fast Search & Analytics Database, Agentic AI ready
posts.description: SereneDB is the result of 12 years of development - an open-source database that does ultra-fast full-text and fast analytics in one engine. Postgres- and Elastic-compatible: keep your SQL, your drivers, and your Elastic clients; drop the second system and the ETL between them. In our public benchmark, it outperforms Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, and Postgres search extensions, and indexes 1B logs in under 8 minutes at ~10x less disk. Apache 2.0, methodology, and raw results are public.

posts.name: Pulsetic RUM
posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors
posts.description: Pulsetic is uptime monitoring that measures your real visitors too. One async script reports Core Web Vitals, load-time percentiles and the JavaScript errors they hit, sliced by page, country, browser and device, so you catch the slow checkout that a 200 response code hides. Ask Pulsetic AI what broke last night in plain language. Cron heartbeats, domain expiry and branded status pages run in the same account.

posts.name: Keet
posts.tagline: Learn Anything
posts.description: Learn anything with interactive video courses on any topic.

posts.name: Freebuff Ads
posts.tagline: Advertise to 500k developers in our coding agent
posts.description: Run ads inside the Freebuff desktop app, mobile, web, and CLI - where 500k developers are already working. Pay per click, set your own caps, and measure clicks and conversions in one console.

posts.name: WeWeb MCP
posts.tagline: Your AI agent builds the app. You stay in control.
posts.description: Point Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT or any MCP agent at WeWeb and it builds the pages, workflows, data models, tables, auth and integrations. Every change lands in a visual editor you can review and edit yourself. Your agent, your tokens, your code. No black box.

posts.name: MiMo-V2.6
posts.tagline: Open omnimodal intelligence, trained in public
posts.description: MiMo-V2.6 is Xiaomi’s open omnimodal model family for long-horizon agent work. Pro and Flash handle text, images, audio and video with 1M context, while Xiaomi is also releasing the technical report, RL environments and training code behind the public post-training run.

posts.name: Plane Agents
posts.tagline: Assign work to AI agents, like any teammate
posts.description: Plane Agents join your workspace as members. Assign them work items, tag them, trigger them when work changes, or run them on a schedule. They triage requests, draft specs, run standups, flag delivery risks and a lot more. Agents run on the AI credits included in every paid plan.

posts.name: vgpu
posts.tagline: The WebGPU library, designed for agents
posts.description: vgpu is a TypeScript library for WebGPU: typed shader imports, a tiny gpu-first API, and the same code running in the browser, headless Node, and your test suite.

posts.name: Hola AI
posts.tagline: An AI voicemail assistant that answers calls when you can’t.
posts.description: Hola AI answers calls when you can't, speaks with callers, takes messages, filters spam, and sends instant call summaries. It also records and transcribes conversations, helps you understand why someone called, and gives you the context you need before calling back. Stay reachable without picking up every call.

posts.name: Googlebook
posts.tagline: The laptop your Android phone has been waiting for
posts.description: The first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence. Googlebook is crafted with premium materials for powerful performance, and syncs effortlessly with your phone.

posts.name: gg-friggin-ez
posts.tagline: Fast & free profanity and toxicity screening via Jev & Laya
posts.description: Fast, free, drop-in multilingual profanity and toxicity screener for Node.js, powered by System 1 models like TypeSafe AI Jev and Laya. Catches leetspeak, ASCII drawings, character spacing, and romanized profanity across all languages including Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, and Bengali. Ultra-low cost • Multilingual • Native Indic support • Evasion-aware • Sub-500ms • ~$0.000004/message • Configurable moderation actions • Open source (npm i gg-friggin-ez)

posts.name: Fulvid
posts.tagline: A standalone desktop editor for Markdown and MDX
posts.description: Fulvid is an open source Markdown and MDX editor for open knowledge. Keep your knowledge in portable Markdown files on disk, ready to read, link, reuse, version, and work with across tools and LLM workflows. Search, preview, document links, and Graph navigation stay close to the filesystem. No proprietary vault or cloud workspace.

posts.name: QuietGlass
posts.tagline: Screen privacy for your Mac, with or without AirPods
posts.description: QuietGlass is a free, open-source Mac app for screen privacy. Look away with compatible AirPods and your screen blurs. Your camera can spot another face in view and warn you or blur the screen, even while you're still looking. Protect a window or selected area, blur sensitive text, or keep your active window clear with Focus mode. Optional owner recognition checks it's you before clearing camera protection. Native Swift, notch controls, and processing on your Mac. macOS 14+.

posts.name: Grok 4.7
posts.tagline: SpaceXAI's most powerful model for coding and knowledge work
posts.description: Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date. Served at the same price and speed as Grok 4.6, it is highly competitive in its class.

posts.name: Blurt
posts.tagline: Push-to-talk dictation on the AssemblyAI Dictation API
posts.description: Hold a key, talk, and the words land wherever you're typing. Blurt is a free, open-source Mac dictation app powered by AssemblyAI's Dictation API.

posts.name: PixelCrew
posts.tagline: Production-ready design from a crew of AI agents
posts.description: A crew of specialized AI agents coordinates on your brief and ships production-quality design. Research, creative direction, wireframes, and production-ready HTML with a design system. You can watch the agents discuss decisions while it runs. Free in alpha: bring your own OpenRouter key and run the crew on whichever models you like.

posts.name: Edyt
posts.tagline: AI for text you can't even select. Any app on Mac & Windows
posts.description: AI in every app, on Mac and Windows. Ubuntu next. Select text, press one shortcut, and the result lands where your cursor is. Rewrite keeps your tone and follows your instructions. Explain and Translate go as deep as you ask. Alternatives shows several ways to say it. Saved prompts run on anything you select and follow your account to every machine. Can't select it? Hold Option or Alt and drag over a PDF, screenshot, or shared screen. Read on your device. Free plan is enough for most people.

posts.name: Brev
posts.tagline: Set your goals. Brev does the rest.
posts.description: Brev acts like your AI coworker in Slack who's really good at hitting goals. Tell Brev your team and company targets, and let it do the rest. Brev uses AI to connect goals, meetings, metrics, decisions, and work across the tools teams already use, so leaders can see where execution stands, understand why things are off track, and act earlier.

posts.name: Fez
posts.tagline: AI agents that work as a team and make decisions together
posts.description: A desktop app for Mac where several AI agents work together as members of one workspace, and the room decides who takes what. Built on nostr and jev

posts.name: Diurnal
posts.tagline: The fastest way to get a thought out of your head
posts.description: A native Mac app for planning your day. Press ⌥⌘ K over anything, or hold ⌥⌘L and just say it, and it lands on the right day. Your Google Calendar sits beside your tasks, reminders ring at their time, and it all works offline.

posts.name: VideoFlow Studio
posts.tagline: Type your startup URL and get a premium video trailer
posts.description: VideoFlow Studio is a video agent harness. Run `npx @videoflow/studio`, point it at your site's URL, and a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) reads what your product does, plans a film, builds it, renders it, and reviews its own cut before handing it back. No templates — the plan comes from your product, not your page's headings. The output is editable: open it in the built-in editor, or just ask for a change in plain English. Open-source rendering engine. Free to start.

posts.name: FeedsBar
posts.tagline: A quiet, continuous news/media ticker for your Mac desktop
posts.description: FeedsBar streams high-signal headlines across your Mac desktop in a slim, always-on ticker, fed by the Signal 500: 500 sources hand-scored on editorial quality and ad restraint. Topic orbs reduce a cluster of headlines to three phrases. Play music and the ticker re-tunes to that artist. Add your own feeds and symbols, or send it full-screen as an ambient board. Native macOS, no account, no tracking. 7-day free trial, then $24.99 once, no subscription.

posts.name: Walkie
posts.tagline: Dictation + meetings + read aloud in one app on-device
posts.description: Walkie turns speech into polished text in any app, gives you meeting transcription with notes and who said what, and reads anything aloud in 950+ voices — free and fully on-device when you want. Mac, Windows, Linux, and iPhone.

posts.name: Shootsolo 2.0
posts.tagline: Voice-controlled camera + teleprompter for solo creators
posts.description: Film yourself hands-free. Say "Start Recording" and "Stop Recording," keep or discard each take, read your script from the built-in teleprompter, light your shot with virtual studio lights, and record portrait + landscape in one take. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Contextberg
posts.tagline: Local AI agent memory served via MCP
posts.description: Contextberg brings local AI agent memory to macOS and Windows. It captures screens, browser history, and agent conversations into a private, searchable archive, then serves relevant context to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents over MCP. This launch adds native macOS capture, OCR screenshot search, source exclusions, and flexible model routing: use your existing Codex sign-in, a Gemini/OpenRouter API key, Contextberg Cloud, or a fully local model.

posts.name: ResumeContext
posts.tagline: Shared memory for coding agents.
posts.description: One shared archive of every coding-agent session, handed back through MCP. Two things it fixes: your team’s context stops being trapped on each laptop, and switch between coding agents without loosing context.

posts.name: 2BA.AI
posts.tagline: Stop waiting for tokens, and start shipping
posts.description: EU-hosted AI infrastructure for developers. Install with one command and get 4,500 requests per rolling 5-hour window for a flat €20/month — no token counting, no surprise usage bills. Works with Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and any OpenAI-compatible client. Zero logging. 100% EU hosted. GDPR native.

posts.name: OneStream Live 2.0
posts.tagline: Create, schedule, multistream & sell live on 45+ platforms
posts.description: OneStream Live 2.0 brings five ways to go live into one platform for creators, businesses, and teams: browser-based Studio, external encoder streaming, pre-recorded streaming, Stream Players, and Custom Websites. Multistream to 45+ social platforms and the web, manage streams from mobile, and use tools like Teleprompter, Live Sales, Unified Chat, team workflows, and 24/7 streaming. Free to start. Trusted by 2M+ users worldwide.

posts.name: Xem
posts.tagline: Open-source email marketing with managed SMTP
posts.description: Create newsletters, email campaigns and visual automations in one open-source workspace. Xem includes reusable templates, signup forms, contact lists and analytics. Connect your own SMTP provider or use managed sending through Amazon SES, with domain verification and workspace approval.

posts.name: Valori
posts.tagline: The deterministic memory layer for AI
posts.description: Valori combines vector search, knowledge graphs, deterministic state, and verification into one memory layer for AI. Build RAG, agents, search, and recommendation systems with memory that can be reproduced and independently verified.

posts.name: Jev Wrapped
posts.tagline: See how much of a Telegram channel is ads and clickbait
posts.description: Paste the name of a public Telegram channel and get a card for its last year. Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, reads up to 1,500 posts one by one and answers four questions about each: which of ten kinds of post it is, whether it is a paid ad, whether it uses clickbait, whether it pushes on fear or anger. The card shows the mix month by month and links the posts that scored highest, so you can check the model yourself. No sign-in, no Telegram account. Open source.

posts.name: Prowler Cloud
posts.tagline: Where your AI agent becomes a cloud security defender
posts.description: Prowler brings open-source cloud security into the agentic era. It combines deterministic, auditable security checks with AI-powered investigation, prioritization, reporting, and remediation. Prowler supports AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, GitHub, IaC and more, with thousands of checks, compliance mappings and attack paths, plus Lighthouse AI, MCP support and advanced compliance workflows. Connect your agent now to start defending your cloud at cloud.prowler.com.

posts.name: ReallyFree
posts.tagline: See what's really 'free' before you click
posts.description: You search for a free PDF editor. Four results in, you've made an account, hit a paywall, and downloaded something with a watermark. ReallyFree puts a coloured dot on every search result before you click. GREEN: genuinely free. YELLOW: free with a condition, named in one word. RED: it costs money. No one can buy a green rating. It's earned. No account, no signup, no tracking. Nothing about your browsing reaches us. Free, and staying free.

posts.name: PewCB
posts.tagline: Vibe-routing is coming. Desktop PCB Factory is here.
posts.description: PewCB is a laser-based desktop PCB prototyping machine that produces factory-grade boards in 10 minutes. OpenAI's latest demo showed Astra creating a device in KiCad. It may not be practical just yet, but it teases what comes next: vibe-routing. Software runs seconds after a code change; hardware still waits two weeks for a PCB. PewCB cuts prompt-to-device time from 2 weeks to 1 hour, enabling 4 iterations a day instead of 2 a month.

posts.name: Robot Voice Bridge
posts.tagline: Run ElevenLabs like a voiceover session, right on your Mac
posts.description: ElevenLabs runs in a browser, so getting a line into an edit means generate, download, find the file, import, repeat. Robot Voice Bridge is a native Mac app that turns that into a voiceover session. Write and direct the script in one window, shape each line with performance tags, fix names with an IPA pronunciation editor, then press S to drop the selected take at the playhead in Pro Tools or Logic. Drag takes into Premiere, Final Cut or anywhere else. Uses your own ElevenLabs account.

posts.name: Reeno
posts.tagline: AI calls you randomly to practice speaking a new language
posts.description: Reeno turns language practice into something that happens naturally throughout your day. Instead of opening an app and scheduling a lesson, Reeno calls you at random times for short conversations with AI. Just answer the call and start speaking. It’s designed to make speaking practice easier to build into your daily routine — spontaneous, low-pressure, and closer to a real conversation than a traditional language-learning session.

posts.name: Clueprint
posts.tagline: See what your agents left running on your Mac
posts.description: Every Claude Code or Codex session leaves something behind - dev servers, Docker stacks, git worktrees, half your RAM. Clueprint is a native menu-bar app that shows all of it live, grouped by project and branch, and cleans up only what it can prove is safe: verified, re-checked, moved to the Trash - never deleted. No Electron, no account, no telemetry.

posts.name: Ama.place
posts.tagline: The Classic Social Q&A Experience, Reimagined
posts.description: A new Q&A network, built from the good nostalgia of Ask.fm — not a replica. Ask people questions, named or anonymous. Answers live on your profile.

posts.name: MeetGeek Desktop App 2.0
posts.tagline: Record, summarize & act on any call
posts.description: No bot joins the call. MeetGeek Desktop records any meeting straight from your Mac or PC — scheduled or ad hoc Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and Webex — plus what bots can't reach: Slack Huddles, WhatsApp calls, and the room itself. Every conversation lands in one structured format you can ask, act on, and automate from the app — or pipe into your workflows via Claude and ChatGPT. Meetings don't just get recorded. They become the trigger for what happens next.

posts.name: Mindspase
posts.tagline: A visual AI knowledge base that organizes what you save
posts.description: Your mind, beautifully organized - Save everything, Manage nothing.

posts.name: Infinite FAQ
posts.tagline: An FAQ section that answers the questions you never wrote
posts.description: A normal FAQ accordion whose last row is a live input. When a visitor's question isn't listed, they type it and get a real answer pulled from your own site — no chat window. Every question asked lands in your dashboard, so you learn what people actually want.

posts.name: Thriven
posts.tagline: Your Career Navigation System.
posts.description: Thriven is your private career navigation system. Through ongoing conversations -or just you logging, about your real work, it collects evidence across jobs, projects, decisions, and feedback and maintains a coherent, evolving model of who you are at work and where you would do your best. Representative finds opportunities informed by your profile, while Application Studio helps you prepare tailored resumes and application materials grounded in your experience.

posts.name: Lirova
posts.tagline: Recover Stripe subscription payments that fail on the card
posts.description: When a renewal fails, the customer usually didn't decide to leave. Lirova classifies each decline, retries what's worth retrying, stops what isn't, and emails only when a card actually needs updating. You pay a fee only on what we recover.

posts.name: MainQuest
posts.tagline: Real life, rendered as an RPG. Unlimited quests and habits.
posts.description: Your tasks earn XP. Your focus is scored. Your friends hold you to it. A real-life RPG, designed for ADHD brains. Free on Android, Web & iOS.

posts.name: Easy 3D Viewer
posts.tagline: Bring your Shopify products to life in real 3D
posts.description: Product photos only show one angle, so shoppers can't always tell what they're actually buying. Upload aglb file, add our Easy 3D Viewer to your store with drag-and-drop blocks, and let customers rotate, zoom, and inspect items from every side. Set custom background, lighting, camera, and animation for each model, preview changes live, then publish. Works on product, home, and blog pages, or anywhere via easy embed, and is compatible with Online Store 2.0.

posts.name: Hemmingway AI
posts.tagline: The best AI in the world at writing like a person
posts.description: A small lab's 27B model that beats every frontier model at writing like a person. #1 on human-likeness and everyday writing, third in the world on the public EQ-Bench 4, at a fraction of their size. Chat on the web, or let it draft your replies. The weights are open, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: Ichigo - Your Positivity Journal App
posts.tagline: We help you unlock art of noticing happiness.
posts.description: 一期一会 ~ Ichigo Ichie - One time, One moment; the tiny thing that happened today. it won't happen exactly the same again. So cherish it. Ichigo is your positivity journal app that helps you cherish encounters that made you smile. with Ichigo we simply nudge you once a day to notice "What made you Smile today?" and answering it overtime builds your sanctuary of positive memories and encounters that brings instant smile to your face. Noticing these tiny moments also leads you to your happier self. ツ

posts.name: AskEngine
posts.tagline: Interview your users. Know what to build next.
posts.description: AskEngine interviews your users by voice. The evidence builds with each interview, and every point is backed by a real quote. Once it's confident, it tells you what to build or fix. If there's a gap, it sets up the next study for you. If an interview fell short, it shows you which user to call yourself. You can read it all in your workspace, or ask your agent through MCP. Interviews cost $5 each.

posts.name: Digital Growth & Automation Session
posts.tagline: Get a personalized roadmap for growth, AI and automation
posts.description: Hatrio Growth Blueprint helps founders turn business challenges into a clear action plan. Bring your biggest growth, AI, automation or digital challenge, and get a personalized strategy focused on opportunities, priorities and practical next steps. Instead of generic consulting advice, every Blueprint is tailored to your business and designed to help you decide what to focus on next.

posts.name: FreeTokens by Lovie.co
posts.tagline: Free LLM tokens. Harvested on your Mac.
posts.description: FreeTokens is one half of FreeTools, a native Mac app. One click signs you up across 20 free LLM providers and collects the keys onto your Mac — around 400 verified chat models behind one local key, and Update Models keeps the list current on your own keys. Nothing of ours in between.

posts.name: Cine 5.1 : Surround audio
posts.tagline: 5.1 audio, 1080p video & watch history for Netflix
posts.description: Cine 5.1 makes Netflix streaming in Safari on Mac better. Enable 5.1 surround audio and 1080p playback for Netflix, while keeping a convenient watch history for Netflix and Prime Video. It's a lightweight Safari extension built for people who prefer watching in Safari but want more from their streaming experience.

posts.name: Vibecode Your Forms
posts.tagline: Stop making and start vibe coding your forms
posts.description: We launched MakeForms AI Form Builder in 2022. Now we are changing the way you build forms with our vibe coding experience. Chat with MakeForms AI and let it build the form, conditional logic in real time. Ask follow up questions till your form is production ready. Once ready, publish the form on your domain and start collecting data.

posts.name: HourDrop
posts.tagline: Own the hour. One product gets the whole homepage.
posts.description: HourDrop gives one product the whole homepage for a booked hour. Brands, businesses and creators bid from $10 or lock an hour for $100 at launch prices, and bring a real discount of at least 20% off. Shoppers get one deal at a time, with no account. The hour goes to whoever books it, with no vote and no editorial pick. A smaller deal of at least 10% off follows for up to 24 hours from the start. HourDrop takes no cut of the sale, and a drop taken down for a fake discount isn't refunded.

posts.name: ActionMode
posts.tagline: AI go-to-market team for founders who build
posts.description: ActionMode is the AI go-to-market team for founders who build. It finds niche businesses, checks ads and evidence, prepares outreach in your voice, and follows up by email — nothing sends without your approval. Named teammates handle research, writing, fact-checking and nurture. Priced per niche, not seats. Built for solo founders and agencies who need follow-through without hiring a sales team.

posts.name: AX by Google
posts.tagline: The open-source runtime for running AI agents at scale
posts.description: AX is an open-source runtime for running AI agents in production. Declare a task and AX gives it an isolated sandbox, prepares its repos, MCP servers and skills, controls network access, and manages models and secrets. Idle agents can suspend while waiting for models, tools or humans, then resume in under a second — with an architecture designed to scale to billions of agent tasks per cluster.

posts.name: Jev API
posts.tagline: Structured AI decisions with probabilities, not prose
posts.description: Jev API turns a state plus typed questions into structured choice, score, and yes/no decisions with probabilities. Use one System One-compatible endpoint, versioned model IDs, prepaid usage, and a public Agent Skill your own agent can install from a link. Built for automation workflows that need machine-readable answers instead of free-form chat.

posts.name: AX by Google
posts.tagline: The open-source runtime for running AI agents at scale
posts.description: AX is an open-source runtime for running AI agents in production. Declare a task and AX gives it an isolated sandbox, prepares its repos, MCP servers and skills, controls network access, and manages models and secrets. Idle agents can suspend while waiting for models, tools or humans, then resume in under a second — with an architecture designed to scale to billions of agent tasks per cluster.

posts.name: JobTarakki: Smarter Careers
posts.tagline: Know where you stand. Know what to do next.
posts.description: JobTarakki helps IT professionals know where they stand and what to focus on next. Start for free → 'Resume Analyser' instantly breaks down your resume. 'Career Check' maps your trajectory. Go deeper with 'Career DNA' — a personalised view of your skills, level, strengths, gaps, and next career moves. Built for developers, testers, support engineers & everyone growing in tech.

posts.name: dotts
posts.tagline: Stop chasing clients for project feedback
posts.description: Dotts makes client feedback simple for freelancers and agencies. Share websites, designs, PDFs and more, invite clients without requiring an account, and collect feedback directly on your projects, so you can spend less time chasing feedback and more time getting work done.

posts.name: RoastWeb
posts.tagline: Roast your SEO, speed, security and AI-search readiness
posts.description: Roast your website's SEO, speed and security, then fix it. One brutally honest audit checks Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, keywords, accessibility, security, and how ready your site is for AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Every problem is explained in plain English, and one click turns the fixes into a ready-to-paste prompt for Claude or Cursor. The free tier shows your full score and everything that's wrong, no signup. The honest alternative to PageSpeed Insights.

posts.name: Scriptlet
posts.tagline: Run package scripts on your Mac, one click away
posts.description: A small native macOS app for running package.json scripts, seeing their status, and keeping output close.

posts.name: MemoryLane
posts.tagline: See what tasks you repeat and how to automate them
posts.description: Desktop app that logs your daily tasks as you work locally on-device, uses AI to spot what you often repeat and suggests how to automate it. Use it to feed n8n, Zapier or any other tool new automation ideas so you don't have to think about it.

posts.name: AI SpendOps
posts.tagline: See which feature is eating your AI budget
posts.description: Your multi-provider invoices arrive as one number nobody can explain. AI SpendOps is a managed gateway that prices every LLM call as it happens and attributes it to the team, feature or customer that caused it. Unlike tracing tools, it is built for cost accounting, not debugging, and it never stores prompts or responses. Point your SDK at it, add one header, keep your own keys. Budgets with email alerts flag runaway spend early.

posts.name: Tingle - See what people are noticing
posts.tagline: Downdetector for everything else
posts.description: See what people are Type what you've noticed, and Tingle checks whether anyone else has. If they have, press Me too. For websites there's Downdetector. For everything else, there's Tingle.

posts.name: PetArk
posts.tagline: All-in-one local pet community, marketplace & AI advisor
posts.description: PetArk is a unified mobile ecosystem for pet parents. Instead of cluttering your phone with multiple apps, PetArk brings everything under one roof: check-in at local dog parks, schedule playdates, access a verified pet services marketplace (walkers, sitters, vets), and broadcast real-time location-based lost pet alerts. It also includes care reminders, document management, and an AI-powered pet health assistant for instant wellness and nutritional guidance. 100% free and built for pet lovers.

posts.name: Saanora
posts.tagline: One AI for research, code, docs, and memory
posts.description: Saanora is one AI for research, code, docs, and memory. This launch is Mark 1x — research the live web with citations, write and code in 20+ languages, generate real docs (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), remember what matters across chats, and work with your team in Rooms. Free to try at saanora.com — no signup on the free tier. Open weights (Mark 1x-9B) on Hugging Face and ModelScope if you self-host. Web · Windows · Android.

posts.name: Burgndy.ai
posts.tagline: The AI app builder that compiles a real app, not a demo
posts.description: Burgndy.ai (Burgundy AI) turns one sentence into a real app, tests it on a real Android emulator and iOS Simulator we host, and submits it to both app stores — no Mac, no emulator farm, no BrowserStack account, no AI-fabricated screenshots.

posts.name: Recent Files
posts.tagline: The file you just made, one click from your menu bar
posts.description: Finder's Recents shows names and dates, which is no use when a folder holds nine files called V3, V3b and V3 FINAL. Recent Files sits in your menu bar and lists what you just touched, newest first, with the waveform drawn into every audio row and every version of a bounce folded into one line. Play a file without opening it. Check its loudness before you send it. Convert to MP3 in place. It watches folders, so it works the same in any app. Free on the Mac App Store, Pro is a one-time £19.

posts.name: Angler
posts.tagline: The iPhone Duo fold, for your Mac
posts.description: Angler is a tiny macOS menu-bar app that holds your desktop at a fixed apparent angle and adds depth as you close the lid: tilt, progressive blur, and more. Use your live desktop or your own wallpaper. Your screen never leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Loops for iOS
posts.tagline: The app for thinkers
posts.description: Here’s how Loops is different: 1. Each note is a thread of thoughts. Ideas typically take shape over time. When you’re done, export it out into an app of you’re choice 2. Carry them with you. Keep a thought front of mind when you go a walk or whatever you do to think. 3. Old notes decay. 60 days, then archived. If it was important you’d have finished it by then. Give it a try. Free forever. It doesn’t cost me anything to maintain so it shouldn’t cost you.

posts.name: Cookie Calm
posts.tagline: Jesus Fucking Christ I accept every cookie already
posts.description: I built Cookie Calm because it's 2026 and Jesus Fucking Christ I accept every cookie already just let me read the article. Join the newsletter. Enable notifications. Download the app. Take a survey! I built Cookie Calm to handle some of those repetitive “no thx” clicks for you. It’s a free Chrome extension that rejects optional cookies by default and closes or minimizes supported newsletter, subscription, discount and other promotional prompts.

posts.name: My Family Tree
posts.tagline: Build your private family tree
posts.description: Build your family tree, discover connections across generations, and preserve your family history with My Family Tree — a private genealogy and ancestry app designed to keep your family story in your hands.

posts.name: Florida Paycheck Calculator (2024)
posts.tagline: Calculate your take-home pay in Florida.
posts.description: Calculate your exact take-home pay in Florida with our free paycheck calculator. Factor in federal taxes, FICA, and see why Florida's 0% state income tax matters.

posts.name: CalPal
posts.tagline: Say it in plain English, keep the calculator.
posts.description: Type a sentence and get a working sheet: named values you can edit, clock times and real timezones, ratios and units that cancel. Change one number and everything below it recomputes. Copy it out with its answers, or share it as a page.

posts.name: MathGPT.app
posts.tagline: Free step-by-step math solver — no account, no card.
posts.description: MathGPT solves maths from text, a photo, or a built-in formula keyboard, and shows every step plus a check at the end. No account, no card — not even for photo uploads. It also checks working you did yourself and names the first line that went wrong.

posts.name: CodeSpotlight
posts.tagline: Make your code impossible to miss.
posts.description: CodeSpotlight makes selected code visually stand out in IntelliJ IDEA with customizable animated effects. Built for coding YouTubers, tutors, instructors, course creators, livestreamers, technical presenters, and anyone who wants their code to be impossible to miss.

posts.name: MakeSMP
posts.tagline: Your Minecraft server, made by AI
posts.description: MakeSMP turns a prompt into a complete Minecraft server package with configs, plugins, permissions, and launch files.

posts.name: Baton
posts.tagline: Turn site photos into handover documents automatically
posts.description: Your crew photographs equipment on site. Baton keeps the evidence, builds the register, and creates the handover as PDF, Excel and CSV in your own Google Drive — automatically.

posts.name: MoonMan
posts.tagline: Escape a collapsing moon mine using gravity & oxygen. 🧑‍🚀
posts.description: One thumb is all it takes to save Earth. Inspired by Tiny Wings, MoonMan is a minimalist gravity escape game originally storyboarded in 2013. Launch off the rock to escape a massive moon mine collapse and maneuver to the surface using oxygen as your only resource. Your jumps and movements are deeply musical, dynamically building the soundtrack as you play. Can you make it out alive? If you fail, the Moon loses its orbit and plummets toward Earth. Beta web app v0.0.3.0 is live! 👨‍🚀💎🙌

posts.name: Peptly: Peptide Calculator
posts.tagline: Peptide reconstitution math, made clear on a visual syringe
posts.description: Peptly turns peptide reconstitution into one clear answer. Enter your vial, your bacteriostatic water and your target dose, and Peptly shows the exact units to draw on a visual syringe. Log every injection, save your mixes, and keep 23 peptide profiles a tap away. On-device. No account needed. Peptly is a calculation and record-keeping tool. It is not medical advice and does not prescribe, recommend or supply anything. Consult a licensed clinician before any injection.

posts.name: AvatarVideoGen
posts.tagline: Turn your résumé into a talking video
posts.description: AvatarVideoGen transforms a headshot and résumé PDF into a polished talking résumé video in minutes. Share it with recruiters, add it to a portfolio, or create role-specific introductions—without filming yourself or editing video.

posts.name: Angler
posts.tagline: The iPhone Duo fold, for your Mac
posts.description: Angler is a tiny macOS menu-bar app that holds your desktop at a fixed apparent angle and adds depth as you close the lid: tilt, progressive blur, and more. Use your live desktop or your own wallpaper. Your screen never leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Unikorn
posts.tagline: Where Vietnam's startups meet early adopters and investors
posts.description: Unikorn connects startups and makers in Vietnam with the people who help them grow: early adopters who try products first and share honest feedback, and investors looking for promising teams. 1,500+ products and 1,000+ makers so far.

posts.name: ReplyStash
posts.tagline: Local WhatsApp reply reminders — no cloud
posts.description: Get a WhatsApp message, mean to reply later, and forget? ReplyStash is a local reply inbox: share text into the app, name the person, choose a reminder schedule, open details, then mark it replied so alerts stop. - Android Share capture - Readable pending list with contact names - Local reminders on your schedule - No account or cloud sync; data stays on-device For work follow-ups, sales threads, appointments, and chats you don't want to lose. Focused on replies, not a full reminder app.

posts.name: ville™
posts.tagline: Stay close to the people who matter.
posts.description: ville™ helps you stay close to the people who matter. Keep track of meaningful interactions, set simple relationship goals, and get gentle reminders when it’s time to reconnect with friends, family, mentors, and others you care about. Your relationship data is private by design. People, interactions, notes, and goals are encrypted before they leave your device, and the encryption keys stay with you. We can’t read, sell, or monetize your personal relationship data.

posts.name: SlapStick
posts.tagline: A Sticker You Can Actually Peel
posts.description: SlapStick is a playful sticker playground where you can explore 1,900+ emojis, build on an endless canvas, decorate photos, and turn your own images into custom stickers with real-time AI. Create cutouts, refine them with resizing, glow, and erasing tools, then slap them onto your wall or photos. Simple, interactive, and made for endless creativity.

posts.name: UGC Rate Calculator
posts.tagline: UGC rates by tier and deliverable, plus a rate card builder
posts.description: How much should a 30-second UGC video cost from a nano creator vs a 100k creator? This page answers it two ways: a benchmark table (9 deliverables x 4 tiers, low/typical/high) and a calculator that turns deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, rush and raw footage into an itemised rate card you can copy and share. Methodology is on the page. No signup.

posts.name: ERLİK
posts.tagline: Activity & focus intelligence for developers, 100% local
posts.description: ERLİK tracks where your time actually goes on a Mac — which apps, which projects, which git branch — and keeps every byte on your machine. No account, no telemetry, no cloud. Pure Swift for Apple Silicon: a menubar widget, a local dashboard on port 5757, and a clipboard history with pinnable boards. Two Macs sync directly over Tailscale/SSH, never through a third party. For developers who want a tracker's insight without handing their activity to someone else's server.

posts.name: Wispro for Chrome
posts.tagline: Stop typing, start talking, get perfectly written text
posts.description: Wispro is a free Chrome extension that turns your voice into text directly inside any website. Unlimited dictation, no subscriptions, and no word limits. Works in 15+ languages, with custom shortcuts and vocabulary support. Your voice becomes your fastest keyboard. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and your words appear instantly in emails, documents, forms, AI chats, and any text field.

posts.name: DockAlly
posts.tagline: One Dock per kind of work, with animals living on it
posts.description: DockAlly rebuilds your real macOS Dock for each kind of work. Apps grouped, recent files stacked by the Trash, windows put back, focus timer. It can switch on its own once it learns your habits. And seven small creatures live down there and nap when you leave.

posts.name: Ish
posts.tagline: An assistant who works for you
posts.description: Ish is an AI assistant who works for you. Give her a project to see through or a responsibility to keep up with: coordinate a team lunch, arrange a dinner, or handle a purchase through delivery. She can email, make phone calls, use Slack, and work inside apps as you or as herself. You set the permission level.

posts.name: Inertia Start
posts.tagline: The monetization-ready Laravel + Inertia + Vue foundation
posts.description: Most SaaS starter kits are built with React and Next.js. The Vue ecosystem has options, but none as complete. So I built one, packaging everything I learned from my years as a Laravel and Vue developer. Auth: 2FA, passkeys, magic links, OAuth login with Google or any Socialite provider. Stripe and Paddle with one-time payments and subscriptions. Teams with roles and permissions. Privacy-first analytics. Theming and localization. Admin area. Pay once, use it in unlimited projects.
